text: It has come to my attention that Mirik Milan, Jim Peters and Jocelyn Kane of the Responsible Hospitality Institute (RHI) are in Toronto today. RHI is a non-profit organization dedicated to helping cities plan their nightlife to create safe, vibrant and economically prosperous places to socialize. The City of Toronto is currently participating in an international study led by RHI on effective and sustainable models for night time economy management. It would be beneficial for the Economic Development Committee to receive a presentation on RHI's study.
The Economic Development Committee received the item for information.
